source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: hole order is a guess: no hole map found; greens are the ones on OpenStreetMap plus two seen on the photo (the waterfall peninsula green and the green at the south end of the strip west of the big lake); numbering follows a loop that fits the card's pars and a few published notes (16 is a par 3 over water, 18 a par 5 with water down the left)
unsure.8: par 5 but the only corridor left fits a short hole; tee placed from the photo, traced length well under the card
unsure.16: the waterfall peninsula may be the 16th tee rather than its green; drawn as the green
unsure.17: tee placed on the peninsula's east side; shorter than the card
